intro: I am a Singapore Polytechnic graduate with a Diploma in Information Technology, specializing in User Experience and Interface (UI/UX) design. After my internship at Amber Creative as a Full-stack Software Developer, I took on freelance projects for clients before starting my own app, StillGood, which is now live on the Google Play Store. Next, I will be serving my National Service until 2028, before pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering at the Singapore Institute of Technology (SIT) from 2028 to 2031.
